emails.subject: Memo before the board sits

emails.body: Mark, we're good to go!
emails.subject: Locked in for sign-off meeting

emails.body:
It's official: the new site goes live on {dom:10,+2m @09:00-09:30}. That's the moment everything else hangs off of, so treat {!launch_day = dom:10,+2m} as fixed. 

Also need your sign-off on a couple of things that I will be sending through momentarily; get them done by{dom:3,+2m}!
emails.subject: Launch day locked

emails.body: Press embargo lifts at {@launch_day @06:00-06:30}, three hours ahead of the site, so the coverage is up first. Block that on your calendar as the embargo lift so nobody schedules over it.
emails.subject: Embargo lifts at six

emails.body: No more changes to the hero film or the campaign stills after the freeze. I need everything final and handed to production by {@launch_day-1w}, end of day at the latest. Put a task on me so it doesn't slip.
emails.subject: Design locked

emails.body: Every retail floor gets stripped and re-skinned to the new branding the night before we go live, {@launch_day-1d @20:00-23:00}, so customers walk into the new era Monday morning. Block the floor reset so the regional leads see it locked.
emails.subject: Store floors reset overnight

emails.body: I want a full dress rehearsal of the site flip before the real thing, the whole team on the call watching the cutover end to end. Hold {dom:6,+2m @10:00-11:00} for the launch dry run.
emails.subject: Dry run of the flip

emails.body: Hey Mark, I want to walk you through a teaser plan so that the rebrand doesn't give whiplash. Does {dom:30,0m @11:00-11:45} work for you?
emails.subject: Teaser campaign?

emails.body: I've sold ACME boots for 22 years to people who trust exactly what this name has always stood for. This futuristic relaunch feels like we're throwing all of that away for a trend. I'm asking leadership, please, rethink it before it's too late.
emails.subject: Please reconsider this rebrand

emails.body: Hey Mark, heard that PR wants a slow warm-up. I think that's a big mistake. The impact here lies in shock value; teasers would ruin that. My recommendation is that we go completely dark until {!acme_reveal = dom:10,+2m}.
emails.subject: Hard no on teasers

emails.body: Got your decision, we go cold, no teasers. I disagree but it's your call and I'm behind it. No reason to keep the teaser review on the books, so we can cancel that.
emails.subject: Standing down on teasers

emails.body: I've got a steady stream of worried people at my door about the rebrand, and it's turning into a real retention risk. Can we grab 45 minutes on {!HR_morale_sync = dom:10,+1m}?
emails.subject: We need to talk about morale

emails.body: Following our chat, the cleanest fix is one company-wide webinar where you lay out the why directly. Run it a few days before the reveal so it's fresh going into launch week. I think three days before {@acme_reveal} at {dom:7,+2m @10:00-11:00} would be optimal, so let's set our calendars for that.
emails.subject: All-hands to get everyone aligned
Launching: Sponsoring Eugene Marathon

emails.body:
I think this is an amazing idea! We have just over 2 months to get this done. Can we please all have a meeting to properly launch and create a plan for this. Lets do {!launchmeeting = this:THU @10:00-12:00}. 
Everyone please block their calendars for this meeting.
Best, Ops
emails.subject: Launching: Sponsoring Eugene Marathon

emails.body:
Hi, 
I will be unable to attend the launch meeting since I will still be at the NYC location. Can we push the meeting to {this:FRI} past 1pm? 
Let me know,
CFO
emails.subject: Launch Meeting Conflict

emails.body:
Hi CFO, 
No worries at all, unfortunately we cannot push the meeting to Friday, we have the employee party that day. CEO will send you a meeting link before {this:THU} so you can hop on remotely. 
Best, 
Ops
emails.subject: Launch Meeting Conflict

emails.body:
Hi team! 
Thanks for a great launch meeting! This is going to be a great sponsorship and event. Below is a recap of what we discussed about the event and next steps moving  forward. 
CFO: In charge of master budget and making sure team is supported financially.
Ops: Research the Sponsorship Tiers and send to CEO once complete to sign off on. 
Marketing Team: Once logistics are completed please put together a pitch deck for the team. We have our pitch to the race director on {!sponsorshippitch = dom:9,+1m} that the "Pitch Team" will run: CEO, COO and, VP of Marketing.
Thanks and let me know if anyone has any questions. Once we get these nailed down we can begin to plan our presence at the event.
Best, 
EA
emails.subject: Launch Meeting Recap

emails.body:
Hi, 
Can CFO please send me the master budget we have for this event? I need to know our max budget. Once we have this we can have a better idea of which sponsorship tier to select and move forward with the event. 
Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Race Sponsorship Budget & Goals

emails.body:
Yes I have attached the Master Budget Plan below. Let me know if you need anything else from me as of right now. CEO will need to sign off on the final sponsorship tier/budget you choose from.
Best, 
CFO
emails.subject: Race Sponsorship Budget & Goals

emails.body:
Hi CEO, COO & CFO
Below are the sponsorship options for the Eugene Marathon:
Gold Tier: Donate +15k - Name on Merch, Website, and Prime Event Pop Up Spot, Free Advertising Through the Eugene Marathon Marketing.
Silver Tier: Donate +8k - Name on Merch, Website, Prime Event Pop Up Spot.
Bronze Tier: Donate +3k - Name on Website and a Event Pop Up Spot
Keep in mind this is the sponsorship cost and does not include all other costs associated with making this happen. 
CEO please let me know which option we will go with before {!approval_of_tier_budget = dom:19,0m} and make sure it aligns with budget.  
Best, 
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Sponsorship Tiers

emails.body:
We are going to meet a week from today to discuss and have the final approval of the sponsorship tier and budget for this event. I'll send out the link by tonight! 
Thanks, 
Ops
emails.subject: Approval of Budget & Tier

emails.body:
Now that budget and tier is confirmed can the Marketing team please put together a pitch deck for the race director. We need this by{dom:30,0m} so that we have a week for the Pitch team to get prepared. 
Thanks, 
COO
emails.subject: Pitch Deck

emails.body: Yes lets schedule a meeting for July 2nd that preps the pitch team for this. VP of marketing will lead the briefing.
emails.subject: Pitch Deck

emails.body:
Pitch went amazing! 
We have secured our Gold Tier 
Great job to the VP of Marketing and CEO for helping us be well prepared. Now lets put all of our effort over the next month into getting the Event Pop Up good to go!
I expect all people involved to block their calendars for August 10th and being present at the event.
Best, 
COO
emails.subject: Approval of Event!

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

We have it down to two good windows for the World Cup cleat reveal. The earlier one gives us a clean run of press and plenty of time to get the shoe into stores before the first match. The later one is closer to kickoff and may get more buzz, but it leaves a tight window to make and ship the shoe in time, since the tournament starts on a fixed date no matter what.
Both choices affect when we book the venue and lock in athletes. I need your call by this {this:FRI} so I can start booking. I think we should go with the earlier window.

Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: WC cleat launch window options

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Just following up so we stay on track. If I don't hear back by {next:MON}, I'll go with the earlier window and start holding venues. I'd rather not do that without your okay, since it locks in spending.

Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: WC cleat launch window options

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Quick update before the board greenlight. Two of our three samples are here and look great. The third one, the outsole from our tooling vendor, is running late and may not make it in time for the review. A push from your office would mean more than one from me. Could you ask them to get it to us by {this:FRI}?

Best,
Design Lead
emails.subject: Prototype status ahead of greenlight

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

One more thing. The vendor says they can hit our deadline only if we confirm the PO {this:FRI}. I'm flagging it because the greenlight assumes all three samples are on the table. If the outsole isn't there, the board will probably push the decision back.

Best,
Design Lead
emails.subject: Prototype status ahead of greenlight

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

The board is ready to greenlight the World Cup cleat. We want a live call instead of a written sign-off, since the spend is large. I'd like to hold it {next:MON}, while the samples are still fresh. Can you put this on the calendar?

Best,
Board Chair
emails.subject: Greenlight call for the WC cleat

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

One condition before the call. The greenlight only holds if we stay under the budget cap the CFO sent around. If the numbers have changed, I'd rather know before we meet. If not, the call stands.

Best,
Board Chair
emails.subject: Greenlight call for the WC cleat

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

The greenlight is done, so we can move on the athlete. We have draft terms from the striker's camp to headline the reveal. The numbers are large but in line with what a World Cup face costs. I need you to review the letter of intent and give a yes or no by {this:FRI}. His agent is holding the slot for us only until then.

Best,
Board Chair
emails.subject: Endorsement terms for the reveal

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

The agent now says he can hold the slot until next {next:WED}, so we have a little more room. Pushing the review date back to then. No need to rush it through today.

Best,
Board Chair
emails.subject: Endorsement terms for the reveal

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Venue is confirmed for the reveal. Based on the earlier window you picked, we are set to hold the reveal event on the {dom:13,+1m}. It needs you on stage, so I'm putting it on your calendar now.
Let me know if anything on your end conflicts.

Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Reveal event date and venue

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Quick note. The striker can only do media the week of the reveal, so we want a short run-through with him the day before the main event. Adding a reveal rehearsal to your calendar for the {dom:12,0m}. I'm also locking the run of show. You and the Design Lead both have speaking slots on stage at the reveal, so I'm putting her design walk-through slot on the calendar for the reveal date as well.

Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Reveal event date and venue

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

We have a problem. The design freeze slipped, so finished shoes for the stage won't arrive in time for the {dom:13,0m}. I need to push the reveal event back to the {dom:20,0m} to have real product on stage. The rehearsal moves with it, to the {dom:19,0m}. This is the cleaner fix. Holding for your okay before I tell the venue.

Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Reveal event date and venue

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

We want to brief press under embargo before the public reveal. I'm setting the press briefing for the {dom:6,+1m}, a week ahead of the reveal.
The embargo plan needs your sign-off so legal can send it to outlets. Can you approve it by next {next:TUE}?

Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Press briefing and embargo

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Since the reveal moved to the {dom:20,0m}, the press briefing is now too early and would break embargo for two full weeks. Moving the press briefing to the {dom:13,0m} to keep it a week ahead of the new reveal date.

Best,
VP Marketing
emails.subject: Press briefing and embargo

emails.body:
{!Budget_Approval_Deadline = this:FRI}Hi Mark,

The reveal event plan came in about 30 percent over the cap the board set. The overage is mostly venue and the athlete's media day.
I've built a trimmed version that lands under the cap. I need you to approve the revised event budget by {!Budget_Approval_Deadline = this:FRI} so marketing can keep booking without overcommitting.

Best,
Chief Financial Officer
emails.subject: Reveal event budget is over

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Following up since the budget approval didn't come through {@Budget_Approval_Deadline}. Marketing has booking calls waiting on it. I've moved the approval deadline to this {this:WED}, but that's the last safe day before we lose the venue rate.

Best,
Chief Financial Officer
emails.subject: Reveal event budget is over

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

With the greenlight done, we're ready to lock the design. The final colorway is attached. Once you sign the design freeze, no more changes go in and we hand off to manufacturing. I need your sign-off by {dom:19,0m} to keep the factory slot we're holding.

Best,
Design Lead
emails.subject: Final colorway for sign-off

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

We hit a snag. Marketing wants a tweak to the heel logo for the cameras, and the factory needs the change drawn up and re-checked. That pushes the design freeze sign-off to {next:WED}. I know this is tight against manufacturing, so flagging it early.

Best,
Design Lead
emails.subject: Final colorway for sign-off

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

The factory won't start cutting tooling until the purchase order is approved. It's a big number, so it needs your name on it, not mine.
Please approve the tooling PO by {this:FRI}. Any later and we lose the production slot that the reveal date depends on.

Best,
Chief Financial Officer
emails.subject: Tooling PO needs approval

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Freeze is signed and tooling is approved, so we're go for production. I'm putting the manufacturing kickoff on your calendar for {this:WED}. It's short, mostly so the factory hears the timeline from you directly.

Best,
Design Lead
emails.subject: Manufacturing kickoff

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

I need to raise something separate from the timeline. On the last launch, my team's work was left off the credit roll entirely, and the design got presented as if it came from the top. I let it go then. I won't this time.
I'm not willing to stand on stage at the reveal unless my team is named as the designers of this boot. I'd like to talk it through with you directly. Can we meet {this:FRI}?

Best,
Design Lead
emails.subject: Manufacturing kickoff

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Thanks for hearing me out. Until the credit question is settled, I'm pulling myself from the reveal lineup, so please take my stage slot off the run of show. I'm not walking away from the boot, just the stage, and only for now.

Best,
Design Lead
emails.subject: Manufacturing kickoff

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Word reached the board that our lead designer has pulled herself from the reveal over how credit was handled last time. With the striker and the press already locked in, this could turn into a story we don't want.
I'm calling a board sync for {this:THU} to get ahead of it. Putting it on your calendar.

Best,
Board Chair
emails.subject: Board sync on the credit issue

emails.body:
Hi, 
The end of year pizza party is coming up! I know the team is really looking forward to having you there. I'm thinking next Monday is best- good way to kick off the week. Can't wait!!{serve }
emails.subject: End-of-year pizza party

emails.body: The main conference room has been booked on 6/8 for the end-of-year pizza party.
emails.subject: Conference room reservation

emails.body: We've narrowed our choices down to 3 pizza places. We wanted to try something new after last years. Could you look at the memo I left in your inbox and let me know which option by Friday? {!pizza_decision = this:WED}
emails.subject: Pizza place selection

emails.body: The pizza party budget of $1500 has been approved.
emails.subject: Pizza party budget

emails.body: The place you chose requires our final order by tomorrow{!ordering_date = this:FRI} so they have time to prepare it. Please remind me to submit the order before then
emails.subject: Pizza order deadline

emails.body: Our new client requested a meeting with you next Monday to see how the new team is functioning. Could we move the pizza party to June 9
emails.subject: Client demo conflict

emails.body: {!new_party_date = dom:9,0m} works for me, thanks for the heads up
emails.subject: updated pizza party schedule

emails.body: The main conference room isn't available on {!New_party_date = nth:2,TUE,0m}, I've booked our conference room 2 instead.
emails.subject: Room change

emails.body: Here's the rundown of your media push: It all builds to the reveal on {!reveal = dom:10,+2m}. First up is the cover-story interview, {dom:6,+2m @14:00-15:00}. Will follow up shortly with more details.
emails.subject: Press plan for launch

emails.body: We got you the anchor slot on the national morning show the day we go live, {@reveal @07:00-07:30}. Block it as the morning show so nothing else creeps onto launch-day breakfast.
emails.subject: Morning show, launch day

emails.body: The big business podcast, "mind your own business" wants you the week before launch. Any of these afternoons works, pick one: {dom:3,+2m @09:00-10:00}, {dom:4,+2m}, or {dom:5,+2m}, 3-4 PM each.
emails.subject: podcast taping, pick a day

emails.body: You're confirmed for a keynote at the footwear expo, {dom:12,+2m @11:00-12:00}. Hold it as the expo keynote.
emails.subject: Keynote at the footwear

emails.body: The expo shuffled the mainstage and bumped you a day. The keynote moves to {dom:13,+2m @11:00-12:00}[insert date → the 13th, +2 months, + add time 11:00 AM-12:00 PM].
emails.subject: Keynote slot swapped

emails.body: Lined up a friendly evening news segment the day after launch, {dom:11,+2m @18:00-18:30}. Mark your calendars; you're gonna crush it!
emails.subject: local evening news opp

emails.body: The station had to bump us and couldn't reslot in time. Cancel the news segment, we'll catch the next cycle.
emails.subject: News hit fell through

emails.body: We're locking the Atlas launch plan. Code freeze is set for {!atlas_freeze = next:MON @09:00-10:00}; please hold that hour for the go/no-go. Public launch is targeted for {!atlas_launch = next:MON+10w}.
emails.subject: Project Atlas: code freeze Monday, launch in 10 weeks

emails.body: Note for you to action: once Atlas launches, get my first press interview on the books the week after at {@atlas_launch+1w @11:00-12:00}.
emails.subject: Set up my launch-week press interview

emails.body: FYI only: the Atlas trademark cleared this morning, so marketing is unblocked on the name. No action needed from you, I just wanted you in the loop.
emails.subject: Re: Project Atlas trademark cleared

emails.body: One to-do for you: the Atlas beta feedback needs to be compiled and summarized by {@atlas_freeze+10bd @17:00}. Add it to your list so it doesn't slip.
emails.subject: Atlas beta feedback: compile the results

emails.body: The board wants a live Atlas demo two weeks after freeze. Please put it on the calendar for {@atlas_freeze+2w @15:00-16:00}.
emails.subject: Atlas live board demo

emails.body: Scheduling is tight that week, so we are pulling the Atlas board demo in to {@atlas_freeze+11d @15:00-16:00}, same hour.
emails.subject: Re: Atlas board demo, pulling it in

emails.body: Let's celebrate the Atlas launch with a team dinner the evening of launch day: {@atlas_launch @19:00-21:00}. Penciling it in.
emails.subject: Atlas launch-night team dinner

emails.body: Change of plan: with the team spread across offices we are going to skip the Atlas launch dinner this time. If it's on your calendar, please take it off.
emails.subject: Re: Atlas launch dinner, let's not

emails.body: Hi Mark. We have a few ideas in place to guide us throughout this rebrand for ACME. Before continuing, can we meet to go over some details regarding our target demographic. I have availability on {this:MON @08:00-09:00}.
emails.subject: Target Demographic

emails.body: Hi Mark. I hope all is well. I wanted to go over some details about our mission statement and core values. Can we grab 30 on {!PR_Meeting = this:MON}
emails.subject: Aligning Expectations

emails.body: Hi Mark. Regarding the previous email I sent, I forgot to mention some things. I need to review style guidelines and acceptable logo designs. This will take longer, we’ll need to meet for longer. I can no longer do Monday, but I can do {!updated_meeting_designlead = this:WED @15:00-16:30}. Please let me know if this works for you.

ops.create: New Meeting with Design Lead to Discuss Target Demogaphic

emails.subject: Reschedule Meeting

emails.body: Hi Mark. I got a request from Marketing to send out a survey to stakeholders to receive feedback on the current rebrand plan. Checking in with you, the new identity and positioning they sent over is accurate and reviewed by you?
emails.subject: Sending out Surveys

emails.body: Hi Mark. Survey results indicate high positive feedback, seems were all set to launch. Just wanted to update you on the process. Would you have 45 minutes {this:FRI} to meet and chat regarding making sure all employees are fluent in the new brand?
emails.subject: UPDATE: Rebrand Surveys

emails.body: Hi Mark. Great news, everything seems to be going super smoothly. All the prep looks about done, should be rolling out the launch as planned.
emails.subject: Rebrand Execution

emails.body:
Hey Mark,

Happy to report, I’ve talked to our lead of design Melissa and it looks like the new batch of shoe designs for Acme will be ready very soon. Afterwards, I will arrange some final look-overs and then we can start producing the new shoes! Let me know if you have any questions.

Thanks,
Damien
emails.subject: Product launch ready soon!

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Unfortunately this second batch of shoes’ designs were not completed in time. I understand we scheduled the release for next week but there were some internal conflicts within our department.

I assure you we will have the designs ready in two weeks and at the same time, our marketing lead will work on advertisements. I believe Josh wanted you to double check his work the day he's done, could you please do that? He said it would be ready on {!advertising_ready = dom:15,0m}.

P.S. I also wanted to discuss privately with you the future of the design team to ensure these internal conflicts never happen again. Let’s schedule a meeting, I was thinking {!melissa_meeting_1 = this:WED @18:00-19:00}.

Best,
Melissa
emails.subject: Design delays - internal conflicts

emails.body:
Hello Mark,

Our budget has been exceeded by 20% and projected to cost even more since we haven’t done advertising yet.

We really need another week to discuss this budget problem. I understand the advertising was suppose to launch on {dom:15,0m} but we need to push this back to {dom:22,0m}. Let’s reschedule that back a week to the 22nd of this month, and we’ll have a budget meeting on {!budget_meeting_bill = dom:15,0m @17:00-18:00} instead.

It’s also good to have another meeting every two weeks. For now, let’s schedule one for {!second_bill_meeting = dom:29,0m}.

Thank you,
Bill
emails.subject: Budget Exceeded

emails.body:
Hey Mark,

I spoke with Melissa as I believe you have too. We came to the agreement that half their team is effectively non-productive.

Let’s schedule a meeting {!design_cut_meeting = serve+3d} to discuss who we can let go.

Before then, can you have 1-2 people in mind? I’m thinking between Alice, Drake, and Bobby.

Thanks,
Damien
emails.subject: Design Team Meeting

emails.body:
Hey Mark,

HR managed to fix the problem with the design team, no need for that meeting anymore as we aren’t firing anyone.

Thanks,
Damien
emails.subject: Re: Design Team Meeting

emails.body:
Hey Mark,

Everything is on track to proceed with the product launch! We were only delayed by a week or so.

Thanks,
Josh
emails.subject: Product launch ready
